findings.summary: The ui.open, refreshPane and first-tick log calls are now fire-and-forget and run concurrently. log() (executor.ts:139) is a read-modify-write on the single hierarchy/log array, so with an asynchronous store two overlapping calls can read the same array and one line is lost. Serialising the logs through a small promise chain would fix it.

findings.summary: void attempt(run) fires an immediate tick in addition to whatever clock.every does. If the host also runs the callback at registration, two ticks run concurrently on the shared dispatch state. A cheap in-flight guard in run would remove the question.

findings.summary: In exists(), clearTimeout(timer) is skipped when call rejects. The 2 s timer lingers and resolves harmlessly. Moving the clear into a finally would be tidier.
